description: How one stock performs against a sector ETF that holds it (its 'lens'): returns over 1w to 1y and the gap to the sector, relative-strength trend, valuation, next earnings date, and every tracked sector that holds it with its quadrant there. Without `sector`, the free tier uses a broad S&P 500 sector that holds the stock and Premium uses its largest-weight sector.
